research_scope: Public Telegram sources that may support emergency population-behavior / citizen-reaction research in northern Israel.
important_limits: This is a source-discovery list, not a validated evidence corpus.
Most public Telegram search results are channels, not true open groups.
For 'real citizen voice', use only direct resident posts/comments/reports. Reject media-style summaries, editorials, official-only notices, and unverifiable claims.
Do not join private/invite-only groups, bypass access restrictions, scrape at scale, or collect unnecessary personal identifiers.
Use alert channels only to create event windows; do not treat them as citizen behavior evidence.

include_if: message contains direct public resident expression or explicit resident report
message mentions relevant locality/region in northern Israel
message relates to UAV/drone alerts, sheltering, routine disruption, fear, fatigue, trust, compliance, or community support
source URL and timestamp can be preserved
exclude_if: official statement without direct resident voice
graphic/irrelevant media or political commentary without behavioral evidence

recommended_use: timeline of alerts and municipal guidance
context for whether residents were told to shelter, evacuate, avoid gatherings, or resume routine
do_not_use_for: direct citizen sentiment unless a post includes quoted residents or links to resident Q&A
sources.collection_notes: Official municipal channel; strong for exposure/instructions, weak for direct citizen voice. Use as context/ground truth around events, then pair with social discussion sources.
